profile.model: Multi-stage generalist whose healthcare team invests from seed and early-stage company formation through growth rounds, crossovers and public PIPEs in life sciences. Biopharma bets skew to clinical-stage small molecules and biologics in oncology, immunology and cardiometabolic disease, plus a growing set of AI-enabled drug developers (Xaira, Pathos) and global in-licensing platforms (Corxel, Avenzo).
profile.summary: NEA is among the largest venture investors in biopharma, with a long record of exits to big pharma (Tesaro to GSK, Akouos to Lilly, Inversago to Novo Nordisk, Verona to Merck). Its ability to fund companies from early rounds through PIPEs makes it a frequent anchor investor around IPOs.
